name: How do I choose the right custom window style for my home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right custom window style for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right custom window style involves considering your home's architectural period, your personal aesthetic preferences, and functional needs like ventilation or ease of cleaning. Popular styles include double-hung, casement, awning, picture, and bay windows. For homes in areas like Oakland Hills, panoramic views might favor large picture windows, while traditional homes in Berkeley might suit double-hung. We can help you explore options during your consultation, ensuring the style complements both your home's design and your lifestyle.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider your home's architecture, aesthetic preferences, and functional needs like ventilation. Popular styles include double-hung, casement, and picture windows; choose one that complements your home and lifestyle.
